EC1: - Uncontrolled medical condition other than PTH
EC2: - Severe additional chronic pain complaint which could [NOT] not be distinguished from headache pain
EC4: - prior treatment with botulinum toxin within one year of enrollment
EC6: - medical condition that would increase risk of neuromuscular junction blockade with botulinum toxin (myasthenia gravis, [OR] Eaton Lambert, [OR] amyotrophic lateral sclerosis)
EC8: - initiation of a new anti-depressant [OR] or anti-seizure medication within three months of enrolling in study
